item.title: Custom Interface for Real-Time Simulation Control
item.description: A custom interface tool using WPF to monitor and modify real-time session data. The tool retrieves and updates parameters, and sends commands via UDP.

item.title: Defense Simulation Software Development
item.description: Developed real-time interactive display systems by integrating the SDK with C++. Performed QA testing on system inputs, ensuring accuracy and debugging complex user interactions.
